Card text. Only "other" Methuselahs pay the penalty in question.

You can move Smiling Jack before you pay your one pool "you" penalty,
but you'll still have to pay the X pool/blood "others" penalty when
you are among the "others".

Another way to look at it is that you can't finish your untap (or any other
phase) without handling all the things that are pending in that phase.

You handle the "you" penalty by transferring SJ, so no need to move the one
pool to Jack. But that queues up another untap phase thing that you have to
handle before you can move to your master phase.

I'm not saying anything different about the specific Succubus Jack
situation, of course, but Josh Duffin explained something similar this way
to me once, and I've found it's a good general rule for all sorts of things.

Josh is useful that way. ;)

- Pat
